description: This file defines a custom exception class 'InteropTransferAlreadyCommittedException' that extends the 'AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException'. It is part of the 'org.apache.fineract.interoperation.exception' package and is used to indicate that an interoperation transfer has already been committed (or is on hold) for a given account and transfer code.

classes.name: InteropTransferAlreadyCommittedException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that an interoperation transfer has already been committed or is on hold for a specific account and transfer code.

methods.name: InteropTransferAlreadyCommittedException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an instance of the exception with specific accountId and transferCode, setting an appropriate error message.
